"use client";

import { Progress, Stack } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const ProgressWithVariants = () => {
  return (
    <Stack gap="4" maxW="240px">
      <Progress.Root variant="subtle">
        <Progress.Track>
          <Progress.Range />
        </Progress.Track>
      </Progress.Root>
      <Progress.Root variant="outline">
        <Progress.Track>
          <Progress.Range />
        </Progress.Track>
      </Progress.Root>
    </Stack>
  )
}

documentation:
# Chakra UI progress

14 published Chakra UI progress examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
